evals.prompt: Review this formal invitation layout specification; do not create or edit a design. Centered alignment, black on white, and Georgia are approved brand choices and must stay. Canvas: 600 × 840. Every line is centered on x=300. 'WILLOW SOCIETY' is 54px bold at y=105; 'Annual Dinner' is 22px regular at y=220; '24 October 2026' is 18px at y=420; '18:30' is 18px at y=447; 'Oak Hall' is 18px at y=474; 'Please RSVP by 10 October' is 18px at y=565; 'rsvp@example.org' is 18px at y=770. The purpose is to invite existing members to the dinner and get RSVPs. All text has space to fit within the page. I only have this specification, not a rendering. Give prioritized, specific fixes, including type and spacing, in review.md. Do not add a fault merely to cover every design principle.
evals.expected_output: A critique tied to the supplied positions and sizes, addressing detached RSVP details and assessing hierarchy while retaining centered monochrome Georgia; visual claims are limited to the specification.
assertions: The output is critique only, with no created or edited design artifact.
The critique identifies the detached RSVP address, explains the reader consequence, and proposes an actionable spacing change grounded in the supplied positions.
Proposed changes preserve centered alignment, monochrome color, and Georgia.
The critique distinguishes specification-based conclusions from unperformed rendered checks.
